security_audit.summary: The shell execution, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives. The documented Leadsets connection sends CRM identifiers for enrichment, but the workflow does not explicitly require approval of that transfer before the first lookup. No evidence of prompt injection or a hidden destination was found.

remediation.issue: The workflow can send CRM identifiers to Leadsets before the user explicitly approves the transfer.
remediation.suggestion: Before the first lookup, show the destination, record count, and identifier types. Require approval of a bounded batch and send only the identifier needed for each lookup.

remediation.issue: Notes, reports, and optional CSV exports can retain unverified addresses and duplicate existing CRM values.
remediation.suggestion: Report counts and record IDs by default. Require approval before saving unverified addresses or exporting contact details, and restrict access to any detailed report.

content.user_title: Enrich Attio People and Company Records
content.value_statement: Incomplete Attio records make it hard to find current roles, work emails, and company details. Use Leadsets to fill missing fields with sourced, dated values while keeping existing data intact.
actual_capabilities: Read existing people and companies from an Attio list, view, or filter.
Check Leadsets usage before starting and use one record to test the match and field mapping.
Fill missing company industry, headcount band, and location from domain matches.
Fill missing roles, companies, and verified work emails, while flagging possible job changes.
Record the source and last-checked date for each update and list proposed changes separately.
Report skipped records, email verification status, and records left for the next usage window.
limitations: Requires an Attio connection with write access for updates and a Leadsets account with MCP access or a REST API key.
Only enriches existing records with usable identifiers. It does not discover new contacts or provide phone numbers.
Does not overwrite existing values without approval or put catch-all or unknown emails in the primary email field.
Leadsets quotas and rate limits can postpone part of a batch. Some lookups return no match.

use_cases.title: Complete a target-account list
use_cases.description: Fill missing industry, headcount bands, and locations for companies in an Attio target list.

use_cases.title: Clean up imported contacts
use_cases.description: Fill missing roles and verified work emails after a contact import. Flag company mismatches for review.

use_cases.title: Plan a quota-limited enrichment run
use_cases.description: Test field mapping on one record, then enrich a fixed batch within the available quota and report what remains.

prompt_templates.title: Fill one company field
prompt_templates.prompt: In Attio, fill the empty industry field for the Northstar Labs company record. Before sending its domain to Leadsets, ask me to confirm.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Update one empty company field.

prompt_templates.title: Backfill verified work emails
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 20 people missing primary email in my Attio Event Leads list. Ask me to approve the batch and identifier types before calling Leadsets. Write only verified emails and report other statuses as counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Enrich a small contact list with a verification rule.

prompt_templates.title: Review company field changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose changes to industry, headcount band, and location for up to 30 companies in my Attio Target Accounts view. Confirm the scope before sending domains to Leadsets. Show the source and date for each proposal without writing to Attio.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review new values before changing existing records.

prompt_templates.title: Run a quota-limited batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Leadsets usage for my Attio Q1 Targets list and cap the run at 80 records. Show the proposed batch and identifier types, then wait for approval before sending data. Test one company first, process companies before people, and fill only empty fields. Flag company mismatches and report remaining records with the reset time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Coordinate linked records, approval, and quota limits.

output_examples.input: Fill missing industry and headcount bands for 15 companies in my approved Attio batch.
output: Filled 18 fields across 10 company records. Each update includes a Leadsets source and check date.
Two companies had no match. Two lacked a domain. One was deferred until the next usage window.

output_examples.input: Backfill verified primary emails for my approved batch of 12 Attio contacts.
output: Wrote seven verified work emails with their sources and check dates.
Held back two catch-all addresses and one unknown address from the primary email field.
Skipped one contact with no usable identifier and one with no match.

best_practices: Approve a specific Attio list, batch size, and identifier types before sending records to Leadsets.
Check quota and test one record to confirm the match, field mapping, and source data before processing the batch.
Review proposed changes and possible job changes before applying them. Keep unverified addresses out of the primary email field.
anti_patterns: Run against every record with missing fields without confirming the scope or available quota.
Treat a catch-all result, unknown status, or old CRM value as proof that an email is verified.
Export detailed contact reports or save unverified addresses in shared notes without checking who can access them.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: Use your own Attio connection and a Leadsets account. Connect Leadsets through MCP or use a REST API key.

faq.question: What data goes to Leadsets?
faq.answer: Company lookups use domains. Person lookups can use an email, LinkedIn URL, or a name and company domain. Approve the scope before sending identifiers.

faq.question: Will this overwrite my Attio data?
faq.answer: By default, it fills empty fields and lists different values as proposals. Existing values require approval before replacement.

faq.question: What happens to catch-all or unknown emails?
faq.answer: They stay out of the primary email field. The workflow can label them in a separate attribute or note and include them in the report.

faq.question: What happens if the batch exceeds my quota?
faq.answer: The workflow processes the records that fit and reports how many remain and when the usage window resets.

faq.question: Can it add new contacts or find phone numbers?
faq.answer: No. It enriches existing Attio records and does not provide phone numbers.
